# Altair full slots

All seven minimal sanity/slots/pyspec_tests cases at
ethereum/consensus-spec-tests commit bc5c1a7fb2a8871aaffd4b16ee4dd9c72bb81908.
Original Snappy, decoded pre/post SSZ, and slots.yaml files are retained with
hashes and upstream paths in manifest.json. This corpus spans 100 slots and
includes historical accumulation and epoch/sync-committee boundaries.
It does not qualify signed Altair block processing or live networking.
